slides.title: Global Transaction Banking Platform
bullets: End-to-End Architecture Blueprint
Confluence of Graph, Kinetic Layer, Streaming, and Real-Time Intelligence
For: Nexus Global

slides.title: Executive Summary
bullets: Building a canonical, ontology-driven GTB platform for Nexus Global: one model across CB/CM/WM.
Goals: control, consistency, cross-LOB visibility, speed, regulatory readiness.
Pillar 1: Canonical graph (Neo4j) as single source of truth for entities, relationships, obligations.
Pillar 2: Kinetic layer (PostgreSQL) for declared actions, rules, functions, and immutable proof.
Pillar 3: Streaming backbone (Confluent Cloud) + Flink on K8s for real-time correlation and decisions.
Pillar 4: Analytics and history in Delta Lake (Databricks); hot cache in Redis; fully governed.

slides.title: Dimension 1 — Logical Model
bullets: Canonical graph is the single source of truth for all GTB entities and relationships.
Unified ontology across CB, CM, WM: no siloed definitions.
Core nodes: parties, products, accounts, transactions, channels, obligations, mandates, vendors.
Key construct: interfaces define behavior across entity types (e.g., IIsSettlementTarget).
Vendor-hosted systems (TF/SCF) modeled via Containment Zone with progressive mapping.

slides.title: Dimension 2 — Materialization Strategy
bullets: Neo4j: operational graph for real-time traversals, ownership, entitlement checks.
PostgreSQL: kinetic layer, mandates, and append-only proof registry.
Delta Lake (Databricks): analytics, history, LOB projections, containment zone.
Redis: hot cache for entitlements, mandates, high-frequency lookups.
Cross-store sync via CDC (Confluent); graph is always the source of truth.

slides.title: Dimension 3 — Platform Infrastructure
bullets: Confluent Cloud (Dedicated): canonical streaming backbone (CDC, kinetic, vendor, governance).
Flink on Kubernetes (AKS): stateful stream computing for correlation, CEP, forecasting.
Neo4j + PostgreSQL: optimized for graph traversal and ACID kinetic/proof workloads.
Databricks/Delta Lake: analytics, history, regulatory reports.
Azure-native: private endpoints, TLS, Unity Catalog governance.

slides.title: Dimension 4 — API & Integration Contract
bullets: Entity Platform API is the sole write path to the canonical platform.
Endpoints are ontology actions (InitiatePayment, ExecuteFXForward, etc.), not raw CRUD.
Every write includes a proof payload; rejected if missing or invalid.
Async via Confluent: domain, kinetic, vendor, and governance events for analytics, risk, vendors.
LOBs and partners integrate via API (sync) + governed Kafka topics (async).

slides.title: Dimension 5 — Governance, Trust, Mandates
bullets: Mandate hierarchy: HumanMandate → SystemMandate → AgentMandate.
No agent action executes without a valid mandate and intact delegation chain.
Proof registry: append-only, SHA-256 chained; every edge has an evidentiary trail.
All kinetic and Flink decisions logged as governance.audit-events in streaming layers.
Fully reconstructible for regulators and internal audits.

slides.title: Stream Computing: Flink at a Glance
bullets: Flink runs on Kubernetes; connected to Confluent and Databricks.
Purpose: stateful, real-time computation across:
- Payments and ledger events
- Vendor-hosted events (TF/SCF)
- Kinetic actions and mandates
Not 'dumb pipes'; Flink joins streams with graph/reference data and enforces rules in motion.

slides.title: Flink Use Case: Reporting (Regulatory + Operational)
bullets: Real-time aggregation of payments, ledger, and trade events using Flink.
Enriched with canonical entity/relationship context.
Produces reporting-ready streams into Delta Lake (tb_canonical.reporting).
Enables BCBS-239-aligned reporting, audits, and regulatory submissions.

slides.title: Flink Use Case: Statements (Payments + Ledger)
bullets: Real-time assembly of statement lines per customer/account from payment and ledger events.
Handles postings, fees, interest, reversals, and adjustments consistently.
Ensures per-entity ordering and idempotency; integrates with statement services via Delta Lake.
Supports transparent, regulator-ready statements from immutable event streams.

slides.title: Flink Use Case: Cash Flow Forecasting (Treasury / TBP)
bullets: Near-real-time projected cash flows from payments, trades, and vendor-hosted events.
Maintains per-entity, per-product horizons (T+0/T+1/T+7/T+30) in Flink state.
Feeds forecasts into Delta Lake for analytics and Treasury dashboards.
Triggers governance alerts when forecasts breach predefined thresholds.

slides.title: Flink Use Case: Liquidity Monitoring (Real-Time)
bullets: Continuous computation of liquidity positions per entity, pool, and currency.
Detects breaches and concentration anomalies via rolling windows and cross-source joins.
Emits governance.alert-events to Risk/Treasury and kinetic.action-events for automatic compensations.
Aligned with existing pool, sweep, and facility ontology and kinetic rules.

slides.title: How It All Fits Together (Summary)
bullets: One ontology, one platform: shared canonical graph across all LOBs.
Actions, not CRUD: declared operations with proof, rules, and governance.
Streaming + Flink as the nervous system: real-time correlation and decisions.
Governance and trust baked in: mandates, audit, and reconstructibility by design.
